text:
Maya (CSM): Quick sync — procurement asked for the final SLA wording and the credit calc before Tuesday. Can we lock uptime, latency targets, and a simple credit example?
Arjun (Acct Exec): They want one doc to hand to legal + procurement. Minimal, unambiguous metrics.
Jonah (SRE): For uptime we usually publish 99.95% monthly availability for hosted API. Latency: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms for standard gen routes.
Priya (CS Ops): If we do 99.95% should we show what credit tiers map to what shortfall? e.g., 99.95–99.9 = 10% credit, 99.9–99 = 25% etc.
Jonah (SRE): Yep. Also call out measurement window (UTC month) and which endpoints are included (api.redwood.ai/v1/generate + streaming).
Maya (CSM): Can you draft the exact paragraph for the SLA doc, Jonah? Procurement will copy-paste.
Jonah (SRE): Draft below — feel free to copy.

```
Uptime: Redwood Inference guarantees 99.95% availability for the hosted inference API measured per calendar month (UTC). Availability is calculated as: (1 - total_seconds_unavailable / total_seconds_in_month) * 100. Latency SLOs apply to successful non-streaming generation requests: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms. In the event of an availability breach, customers are eligible for service credits according to the following schedule: 99.95%–99.90% = 10% credit, 99.90%–99.00% = 25% credit, <99.00% = 50% credit. Credits do not apply to scheduled maintenance with >=72 hours notice or to customer-caused outages.
```

Jonah (SRE): For evidence we'll link a monthly availability export and the Prometheus query we use. Example query (PromQL):

```
(1 - sum(increase(api_http_request_errors_total[30d])) / sum(increase(api_http_requests_total[30d]))) * 100
```

Priya (CS Ops): I can own the evidence bundle and produce the CSV for procurement. Will include: monthly availability, request counts, sample traces for incidents in the window, and the credit calc.
Arjun (Acct Exec): Can we get a one-page summary + that snippet by EOD today? Procurement has a call tomorrow morning.
Maya (CSM): Priya — if you can own, please share the bundle link and a single-line summary I can paste into the procurement email.
Priya (CS Ops): On it. I will upload to the shared folder and post link here when ready. ETA 5pm PT.
uptime-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice: 2023-12-12 03:00–04:00 UTC (applies to non-production infra) — not counted as outage per SLA.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. Jonah — can you final-check the paragraph for legalese? Even small wording changes matter.
Jonah (SRE): Will do a quick pass and post a Legal-ready sentence in 30m.
Arjun (Acct Exec): Thanks team — procurement will be less painful if we hand them one clean paragraph + proof.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Priya ping me the link when uploaded and I'll send to procurement.
